capabilities: generate up to five matching existing tags and three new tags for the current note
apply generated tags to a note's frontmatter
tag text selected in the editor via a command
batch-tag multiple files or whole folders recursively
configure custom OpenAI-compatible or Ollama endpoints, models, and prompt language
extras: README is written in Chinese with an English section header but Chinese body; fuller documentation (quick start, design, development guide) is linked rather than included.
intentEvidence: 本项目继承自 lucagrippa/obsidian-ai-tagger，并在此基础上进行了代码更新和功能增强。
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to automatically suggest or apply tags based on a note's content and your existing tag history.
